title: The Elements
corpus_scope: 698,507 negative units across all twelve objects, 2018–2026 · ground → law → remedy, decomposed at the unit level
question: What does a charge like "lacks novelty" actually say, once split into what was observed, the rule invoked, and the remedy demanded?

figures.title: The decomposition of a charge: novelty
figures.deck: Pick a docket: every charge decomposes into what was observed, the laws it invokes, and the remedy it demands — 26–40% of denials state their rule in words.

claims.statement: 26–40% of denials state their rule in words across the twelve dockets; the rest leave it implicit (min: clarity 26.4%, max: novelty 40.4%).
claims.derivation: count of denials whose rule text was extracted by the sentence-mining pattern / count of all denials, per docket, min and max across the 12 dockets

figures.title: What each charge asks of you
figures.deck: Every docket has a remedy signature: clarity wants writing (90%), baselines want experiments (80%), reproducibility wants disclosure (76%) — and novelty, alone, wants nothing at all 39% of the time.

claims.statement: Novelty leaves 39% of its denials without any road back.
Every other charge offers a remedy 82–92% of the time.
claims.derivation: min/max across the other eleven dockets of 1 - n(remedy=='none')/n(all denials)

claims.statement: Clarity's remedy is 90% writing (articulate), baselines' is 80% experiments (substantiate), reproducibility's is 76% disclosure.
claims.derivation: clarity.remedies.articulate, baselines_ablations.remedies.evidence, reproducibility.remedies.report, each as share of that docket's denials

claims.statement: "Redesign" is rare everywhere — only theory shows any at scale, at 7%.
claims.derivation: theory.remedies.method as share of theory's denials, compared against near-zero for the other eleven dockets

claims.statement: The novelty no-remedy gap is not a terseness artifact: it persists inside every quartile of unit length — novelty offers a fix for 60–61% of its denials in each quartile, against 76–94% for the other objects.
claims.derivation: share of denials with any remedy, computed within each of four unit-length quartiles, novelty vs. the other eleven objects

caveats.text: The sentence-mining pattern that detects a stated rule is a prior about normative phrasing, so all stated-law shares are floors, not exact counts of every implicit rule.

Remedy shares for the eleven extended objects are estimated on 40,000-fix samples per object where fixes exceed that, and each docket's fixes are read through eight clusters — so an exact 0% means rarer than the clustering resolves, a floor rather than a measured absence.
